id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|114c: Rotondo told me about you. You've a sense of justice, and that's admirable. I like you. Shop all you like.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|117f: Are you planning to go out to sea? Then buy our armor and your voyage will be safe! Now then...
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|118f: Please, buy something! Word is our armor stands up to any rough waves!
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|119f: A-all right! I'll sell you armor! So please, spare me...!
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|11ab: Oh? Have we met recently? You look familiar, but maybe it's my imagination. Now then...
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|11e5: Honestly, that Rad doesn't help out and wanders around all day. I wish he'd take after the mayor's boy, Placido.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|11f1: ...Oops, sorry for grumbling at a customer. Now then...
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|120a: ...Oops, sorry for grumbling at a customer. Now then...
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1236: ...Oops, sorry for grumbling at a customer. Now then...
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|11fe: The Mighty Man Contest is about to start and where is Rad wandering? I've got so much I need help with.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1218: ...Want to rest here, even now? I was taught as a child to help anyone in need. Now then...
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|122b: Rad finally seems willing to help out, whatever wind blew in. From where I stand, though, he's got a long way to go!
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1287: Even a Darkspawn is equal before the gods. Please, pray if you wish. Now then...
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|12aa: Don't see your face much, brother. First time in town?
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|12b3: Oops, that was rude of me. Please, take your time.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|12c0: Then I'll tell you. We're called a trade city now, but Gondolia used to be a small harbor.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|12ce: Back then Rotondo was just a merchant, but he struck trade deals with country after country and grew the harbor this big.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|12df: I can run this bar thanks to Rotondo. I can never repay him.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|12f1: Don't see your face much, brother. First time at the Mighty Man Contest?
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|12fb: Oops, that was rude. Everyone in town has prepared carefully, so I hope the contest is a hit again this year.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|130b: Wondering what kind of festival it is? It's hard to explain. Better to just go see it.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|131f: I've got nothing against you, but my customers are scared. Sorry, but please leave quickly.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|132e: Brother, you're being chased by Heliodor soldiers, right? Rotondo told me. Is it okay to be loafing in a place like this?
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|133a: Take my advice. Heliodor soldiers are prowling the town, so it's wiser to get out quickly.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|13b4: Out of all the shops, you picked mine? You've a good eye, customer! Nobody comes, so I've been bored. Now then...
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|13c6: Even with the Mighty Man Contest on, no customers at all and I'm bored. What's wrong with this shop? Now then...
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|13d9: ...Even in an emergency like this, nobody runs into my shop. I'm so bored I'm in trouble.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|13e4: Even if you're the Darkspawn, a customer is a god! I'll do business as usual! Now then...
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|13f8: With the contest over, even fewer customers come. I'm so bored I'm in trouble.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1403: ...Even if you're the Darkspawn, a customer is a god! I'll do business with gusto! Now then...
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1438: Eek, the Darkspawn! What, are you here to rob me?! Take the money!
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1442: ...Huh? You just want to use the bank? D-do as you like! Well then...
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1466: Good day, traveler. Welcome to Gondolia, the trade city where specialties from the whole world gather.

id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|148e: Mayor Rotondo's house? It's the fine building on the east side of town. It's on the map, so you won't get lost.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|14ae: ...This merchant fled back from the Spirit Water Cave to the west. What a dangerous place to go.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|14cf: The Mighty Man Contest starts soon, so traveling merchants have opened stalls. The town is livelier than ever!
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|14e3: This is Gondolia, but... the Darkspawn appeared right before the Mighty Man Contest, and it's chaos.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|14f3: The Darkspawn may still be hiding nearby and it's dangerous. You should evacuate quickly too.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|150f: The Darkspawn showed up recently and the town went wild. Because of that, the Mighty Man Contest was postponed.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1599: We're wandering mages. The merchants in this town are very generous, and we earned good money guarding them.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|15a7: ...I'd like to move on to the next town soon, but the sweets and drinks here are so good that I'm thinking of resting a bit longer.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|15c8: ...I'd like to move on to the next town soon, but the sweets and drinks here are so good that I'm thinking of resting a bit longer.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|15b9: I'm a wandering mage. The merchants in this town are very generous, and I earned good money guarding them.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|15da: We're wandering mages. We were about to leave this town for another.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|15e6: But apparently a Mighty Man Contest is about to start. It sounds fun, so maybe we'll peek before we go...?
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|15f7: Eek... the Darkspawn! I've been eating nothing but cake lately, but I wouldn't taste good anyway!
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1609: I'm a wandering mage, and I like this town so much that I plan to stay a while.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1633: I'm a wandering mage, and I like this town so much that I plan to stay a while.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1616: Are you a traveler? If you're confident in your skill, you should visit Grotto, a town of strong fighters.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1641: Are you a traveler? If you're confident in your skill, you should visit Grotto, a town of strong fighters.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1621: They say Grotto has a huge arena. Every traveler should visit once!
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|164b: They say Grotto has a huge arena. Every traveler should visit once!
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|16b9: Hello, traveler. Have you ridden a gondola, Gondolia's specialty?
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|16c4: Then do give it a try! The small boats from that landing can take you anywhere along the town's canals.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|16d2: The town is a bit of a maze, so sometimes the canals are quicker. Quite handy.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|16e1: Oh, you've already ridden one. Wasn't the sea breeze nice? Travelers always like it.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|16f3: Oh, traveler. Would you like to ride a boat?
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|16fa: Then that's fine. They're all booked until the festival ends. I only wanted to say I can't take you now.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|170a: Oh, too bad. They're all booked until the festival ends. Sorry, but I can't take you now.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|171b: Hmph, Darkspawn! Don't think that kindly face fools me! I'll never let you on this boat!
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1756: Step right up! How about Gondolia's specialty cake? Fresh from the workshop right here!
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1760: Fluffy dough, plenty of cream, and a rich sweetness you'll love! Please try it once!
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|176e: Oh, here to buy cake? Sorry, we're closing. Please come again tomorrow.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|177d: Step right up! How about Gondolia's finest specialty cake?
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1785: You, lovely miss! For your beauty, I'll give you a deal! Fluffy, sweet, and delicious!
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1793: Step right up! How about Gondolia's specialty cake? Popular with beautiful ladies everywhere!
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|17bf: Step right up! How about Gondolia's specialty cake? Popular with beautiful ladies everywhere!
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|179f: Fluffy dough, plenty of cream, melty-sweet and delicious! Please try it once!
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|17ca: Fluffy dough, plenty of cream, melty-sweet and delicious! Please try it once!
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|17ac: Every customer's gone to the main street, so this road is empty. Business is hopeless!
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|17f0: Hey, what's up? ...Where's the dock where ships are moored? It's the building right over there.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1802: Let me tell you. The Mighty Man Contest is a festival to pick the sharpest man for the sea, but its history is surprisingly deep.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1811: This town has long drawn all kinds of people, from tough sailors to refreshing young nobles.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1822: It's said to have started as a way to revive the town, a contest for the mighty men who gathered here.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1835: This area is usually bustling, but today is the Mighty Man Contest. Everyone has gone to the main street or the square.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1844: With no customers, zoning out isn't bad for once. Maybe I'll nap a bit...
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1855: Y-you're the Darkspawn?! No wonder you seemed suspicious!
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|185d: ...Waah, don't kill me! Please, spare my life...!
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1867: Waah, don't kill me! Please, spare my life...!
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1872: Oh, it's you... Rotondo told me about you.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1878: After that, General Jasper's order has Heliodor soldiers guarding the town. Be careful if you walk around.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|18a5: I've run a stall in this town for years. An old woman like me can keep trading thanks to Mayor Rotondo.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|18b3: Rotondo is a famous wealthy merchant with outstanding talent. He understands the secret of the trade.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|18c0: So he governs the town well so that merchants like us can work easily. We're truly grateful.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|18ce: A little girl came by earlier. She studied the adult shoes so earnestly. Must be at an age to try growing up.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|18e1: The little girl who was looking at shoes ran off after a boy. Children's games, I suppose?
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|18ee: Youth is full of energy. Ho ho ho.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|18f7: I'm usually the one selling, but shopping like this is fun too. It makes me feel young again. Ho ho.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1908: No answer. They seem to be trembling in fear.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|193a: Oh, I had a terrible time! I went to the western cave seeking pure, clean water, but...
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1947: It was full of monsters, and a weakling like me could barely escape with my life, never mind find any water...
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1959: What, you came back safe from the Spirit Water Cave? Wow, you're stronger than you look!
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1969: General Jasper told the townsfolk what the Darkspawn looks like, and you look just like him...
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1975: If you wander around town now, you'll surely be mistaken for the Darkspawn.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1985: My business partner now says he wants a magic key that can open sealed doors.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1993: They say a village with ruins has a legend about a magic key, but it's a hard trip.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|199f: First he wanted clean water, now this. What a client whose orders keep changing. Oh dear...
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1a13: I'm a merchant from Heliodor, where everyone's in an uproar over a dangerous criminal called the Darkspawn escaping.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1a23: Thanks to that, weapons sell high and I'm making a fortune! Ha ha!
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1a2d: Ah, festivals are wonderful! My homeland Heliodor is on edge over the Darkspawn, but this town is peaceful!
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1a42: Oh! You're the one from before!
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1a45: ...Rotondo told us. Everyone in town knows you're not a bad person.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1a51: Still, Heliodor soldiers are prowling the town, so I think you should leave soon.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1a81: What are you staring at, buddy? I lost my job and ended up like this because of that Darkspawn.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1a8f: Ever since he escaped, monsters have increased and I've had nothing but bad luck. It's not my fault... *hic*.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1aa1: ...Mumble mumble, that Darkspawn... Huh, who are you?
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1aa8: W-waah! The Darkspawn! You shall not pass here!!
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1ab1: T-the Darkspawn! You shall not pass here!!
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1abb: According to Rotondo, the Darkspawn isn't so bad. I suspected as much from the start.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1ac7: ...I think someone worse than the Darkspawn is plotting something! *hic*
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1afc: A first-class artist like you should only keep first-class genuine art and jewels close at hand.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1b0b: A find that is a crystal of beauty, discovered in the ruins village of Puchalao... Please, just take a look.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1b1c: Today's business talks didn't go well... Well, it's work during a holiday. I'll take it slowly.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1b2c: Taking a break from work once in a while and touring the festival with my wife and daughter is a fine change of pace.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1b45: Hmm. I tried selling the wonderful art I stocked, but I didn't get much of a result in this town.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1b74: Hmm. I tried selling the wonderful art I stocked, but I didn't get much of a result in this town.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1b53: There's no point staying here, so next I'm thinking of trying Puerto Valor, the knights' summer retreat.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1b81: There's no point staying here, so next I'm thinking of trying Puerto Valor, the knights' summer retreat.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1b5f: Knights are as generous as the sea, they say. I've a feeling I'll make a good deal. A merchant's instinct. Ho ho.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1b8e: Knights are as generous as the sea, they say. I've a feeling I'll make a good deal. A merchant's instinct. Ho ho.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1be6: Oh, you're a traveler. Traveling without a ship sounds so relaxing. I envy you.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1bf0: Because of my husband's work, I'm always crossing the seas of the world. I'd love to enjoy a leisurely trip for once.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1c02: This child wants to ride a gondola and won't sleep. It's night already, what a troublesome girl.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1c11: The bustle of this town is incredible. A festival called the Mighty Man Contest is starting, and I'm excited.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1c2a: My husband is going to a resort town called Puerto Valor for work and keeps urging us to leave.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1c37: But we haven't seen the contest, and there are sweets I haven't tried... I'd like to stay a little longer.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1c49: Because of my husband's work we travel the world, and our daughter struggles to make friends her age. I feel sorry for her.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1c5a: Speaking of which, I heard on our travels that somewhere in the world there's a school only for girls.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1c68: If such a place exists, I'd like to enroll my daughter and have her make friends.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1cb7: I said hello to the boy on that bridge earlier but he just stayed quiet. Is he shy?
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1cc4: Hey, I wanna ride a gondola! It glides over the sea like swimming, whoosh!
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1ccf: Where did that quiet boy go? I wanted to play together.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1cdb: Mister, did you know? The Mighty Man Contest is starting!
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1ce2: ...What's a mighty man? Is it yummy? I'm so excited!
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1cee: What's a Darkspawn? Why is everyone scared of it?
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1cf2: ...Anyway, I found something! You can go outside from the third floor!
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1cf9: But when I tried to climb up, Mommy got mad. Aww, boring.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1d05: Huh? Mister, weren't you called a Darkspawn at the contest?!
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1d0c: Hey, hey, I know! A Darkspawn is a Luminary, right! Are you maybe someone amazing?
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1d18: Oh, so a Luminary isn't amazing. How boring.
id./param/region/r007.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1d21: I knew it! You look strong, mister. A Luminary is someone amazing!

tm.「ラハディオさんから 話は聞いたぜ。\n アンタ 正義感があって 立派だな。\n: Rotondo told me about you. You've a sense of justice, and that's admirable. I like you. Shop all you like.
tm.「もしかして 海に出るつもりかしら？\n でしたら うちの防具を買っていけば\n: Are you planning to go out to sea? Then buy our armor and your voyage will be safe! Now then...
tm.「さあ よかったら 買っていって！\n うちの防具は どんな荒波にも負けないって: Please, buy something! Word is our armor stands up to any rough waves!
tm.「わ わかったわ！ 防具は売ります！\n だから どうか お見逃しください……！: A-all right! I'll sell you armor! So please, spare me...!
tm.「あら？ お客さま 最近 お会いしたかしら？\n なんだか 見たことがあると 思: Oh? Have we met recently? You look familiar, but maybe it's my imagination. Now then...
tm.「ったく ラッドったら 手伝いもしないで\n 一日中ほっつき歩いて……。ラハディ: Honestly, that Rad doesn't help out and wanders around all day. I wish he'd take after the mayor's boy, Placido.
tm.「……おっと お客さんに グチっちゃって\n ごめんなさいねえ。さて……: ...Oops, sorry for grumbling at a customer. Now then...
tm.「もう 海の男コンテストも始まるってのに\n ラッドったら どこを ほっつき歩い: The Mighty Man Contest is about to start and where is Rad wandering? I've got so much I need help with.
tm.「……こんな時だけど 休んでいくかい？\n どんな人であれ こまってる人は助けろ: ...Want to rest here, even now? I was taught as a child to help anyone in need. Now then...
tm.「ラッドったら どういう風の吹きまわしか\n やっと 手伝う気になったみたいだけ: Rad finally seems willing to help out, whatever wind blew in. From where I stand, though, he's got a long way to go!
tm.「たとえ 悪魔の子といえども\n 神の前では 皆 等しい存在です。\n お祈りし: Even a Darkspawn is equal before the gods. Please, pray if you wish. Now then...
tm.「兄さん あまり 見ないカオだな。\n この町に来るのは はじめてかい？: Don't see your face much, brother. First time in town?
tm.「おっと……こいつは ヤボだったな。\n どうぞ ゆっくりしてってくんな。: Oops, that was rude of me. Please, take your time.
tm.「じゃあ 教えてあげよう。\n 今でこそ 貿易都市……なんて 呼ばれてるけど\n: Then I'll tell you. We're called a trade city now, but Gondolia used to be a small harbor.
tm.「けど 当時 一介の商人だったラハディオさんが\n 各国との交易を 次々と結んで: Back then Rotondo was just a merchant, but he struck trade deals with country after country and grew the harbor this big.
tm.「こうして 酒場をいとなめるのも\n 全部 ラハディオさんのおかげってことさ。\: I can run this bar thanks to Rotondo. I can never repay him.
tm.「兄さん あまり 見ないカオだな。\n 海の男コンテストは はじめてかい？: Don't see your face much, brother. First time at the Mighty Man Contest?
tm.「おっと……そりゃ 失礼。\n 町のみんなも 入念に準備してきたし\n 今年も: Oops, that was rude. Everyone in town has prepared carefully, so I hope the contest is a hit again this year.
tm.「どんな雰囲気の祭りだか 不思議に思ったろう？\n しかし これがまた 説明が難: Wondering what kind of festival it is? It's hard to explain. Better to just go see it.
tm.「アンタに 恨みはないが\n お客さんが こわがってるんでね。\n 悪いけど 早: I've got nothing against you, but my customers are scared. Sorry, but please leave quickly.

tm.「ごきげんよう 旅人さん。\n 世界中の名産品が集まる 貿易都市\n ダーハルー: Good day, traveler. Welcome to Gondolia, the trade city where specialties from the whole world gather.

tm.「あなた 旅人さん？\n もし ウデに自信があるのなら\n 強者ぞろいの町 グロ: Are you a traveler? If you're confident in your skill, you should visit Grotto, a town of strong fighters.
